summary: A side panel over a scrim for secondary work — filters, drilldowns, stepping through records.

pairs.dont: Reach for a Drawer because the Dialog felt cramped.
pairs.do: Use a Dialog for a focused interruption; a Drawer for work the page's context still matters to.
pairs.why: A drawer leaves the page visible on purpose. If the page behind is irrelevant, the modal was the right shape.

pairs.dont: Set size="wide" on an expanded drawer.
pairs.do: Pick Default 480 or Wide 640 for a side panel; Expanded ignores size.
pairs.why: The file draws five variants, not six — Expanded is already the wide one, inset 80 by 40.

pairs.dont: Ship a record header with no accessible name because it shows a counter instead of a title.
pairs.why: "3 of 227" is not a name. Someone arriving by screen reader gets a dialog that will not say what it is.

pairs.do: One or the other — `label` for record headers, DrawerTitle everywhere else.
pairs.why: Both render a title with the same id and the hidden one wins, so the visible title is silently ignored.

pairs.dont: Swap the chevrons to left and right because the drawer came in from the right.
pairs.do: Keep up and down — they move through the list behind the drawer.
pairs.why: The arrows describe what moves, and what moves is the selection in a vertical list, not the panel.

pairs.dont: Scatter Apply and Reset through the body next to the fields they affect.
pairs.do: Keep the commitment in the footer, where it stays put while the body scrolls.
pairs.why: The body scrolls and the footer does not. An action that scrolls out of reach is one people stop finding.

pairs.dont: Lead with the primary action, or pair it with a ghost button.
pairs.do: Primary last, on the right, paired with a secondary or an outline.
pairs.why: The eye finishes at the right-hand edge, so that is where the commitment belongs — and a ghost beside it reads as a third-tier action rather than the way out.

pairs.dont: Open a drawer from inside a drawer.
pairs.do: Replace the content in place, or step with previous and next.
pairs.why: Two focus traps and two Escape handlers, and nobody can tell which layer they are answering.
